name: Net Avenue Technologies Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2001, Net Avenue Technologies Ltd is in the business 
of selling Indian designer clothes and accessories online[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) NATL is in the business of selling Indian Ethnic wear primarily in South Asian through its websites cbazaar.com and ethnovog.com
b) Company directly sells to end consumer and gets orders from over 100 countries including the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and Canada being the primary markets.
c) In the international market, 100% of company's orders are prepaid orders. 
d) Company provides COD option only in India
e) Company's subsidiaries act as a commission and collecting agent for the holding company

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -28.4% over last 3 years.
